source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
After reviewing the BOM, I have a few questions:

1\. The capacitors in the C1-C18 range are all missing LCSC part numbers. Since those numbers are required for JLCPCB assembly, could you add them? 2. Neither R7 (1kΩ) nor R8 (100Ω) appeared in the original specification. What functions do they serve? 3. The original specification also omitted the R10 and R11 jumpers (0Ω). What is their purpose?

Thanks

value_updates.assembly_bom_part_numbers: Include the LCSC part numbers required for JLCPCB assembly for capacitors C1-C18.
